messages:
sophia: Hey all — I’m Sophia, started on infra this week. I’m stuck on cloud access: I can’t list GCP billing accounts and my AWS SSO role isn’t showing up. Who should I ping for billing + IAM?
sophia: Error I see when I try `gcloud beta billing accounts list`: 
```
ERROR: (gcloud.beta.billing.accounts.list) PERMISSION_DENIED: Permission billing.accounts.list denied on resource //cloudbilling.googleapis.com/projects/123456
```
sophia: For AWS I tried to assume the dev role and get `access denied` from the console when clicking the assigned role tile.

irene: welcome, sophia! :wave: generally billing access is handled by finance + cloud-ops. tagging @devon and @matt (ops-aws) — they can route you. in the meantime, are you in the `redwood-engineers` SSO group?

devon: hey sophia, welcome! quick checklist: 
1) confirm you’re in the `redwood-engineers` group in Okta/SSO.
2) for GCP billing we usually give `Billing Account Viewer` on the billing account and `Viewer` on the project.
3) for cross-project service account creation you’ll need `roles/iam.serviceAccountAdmin` on the target project (if you need to create SA).

commands to paste in cloud shell: 
```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --format=json | jq '.bindings[] | select(.role=="roles/billing.viewer")'
```
if that returns nothing, you don’t have billing viewer.

matt (ops-aws): @sophia I’m ops-aws — for the AWS SSO side we map the Okta group to the role `RedwoodDev` in account `012345678901`. If the role tile is missing it’s either not assigned or you need to re-login. Try clearing SSO cookie or open an incognito window. If still missing, reply here and I’ll check the SSO mappings.

sophia: ok I’m in `redwood-engineers` according to Okta but still no billing list. I ran the `gcloud` command and got the same PERMISSION_DENIED.

devon: permissions might be granted at the billing account level (different resource). I’ll check the billing account binding — give me ~10m. Also, @infra-bot can create a temporary escal ticket to finance for billing viewer if needed.

infra-bot: Ticket created: CI-4782 — `gcp-billing-access-request` assigned to finance-cloud. ETA: ~1 business day.

matt (ops-aws): I checked SSO mappings — your Okta email is present but not assigned to `RedwoodDev` role in dev account. I’ve added the mapping; try logging out of Okta and back in.

sophia: re-logged, I can see the AWS role tile now, clicking assumes role successfully, thanks! :tada:

devon: FYI finance team accepted the CI-4782 request and added `billing.viewer` on the billing account and `viewer` on the project. Confirm you can now list billing accounts.

sophia: confirmed `gcloud beta billing accounts list` now returns the account. Also can create service accounts in the sandbox project. Huge thanks everyone!

irene: awesome — pro tip: add the onboarding playbook link to your bookmarks (docs/redwood/onboarding/cloud-access) and file a ticket if you need more elevated roles.

sophia: will do. tagging here in case anyone else stumbles on the same flow. :+1:
